mechanism: Both drugs can reduce renal perfusion and increase risk of acute kidney injury; ketorolac inhibits prostaglandin-mediated renal vasodilation while dorzolamide causes systemic carbonic anhydrase inhibition affecting renal function.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) closely; consider alternative analgesic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and assess baseline renal status before co-administration.
